description: Source code for Bluetooth Audio Unicast Server implementation, including callback registration, stream control, metadata handling, and state management.

methods.name: bt_bap_unicast_server_register_cb
methods.description: Registers a callback structure for the unicast server, initializing it if not already registered.

methods.name: bt_bap_unicast_server_unregister_cb
methods.description: Unregisters the callback structure for the unicast server.

methods.name: bt_bap_unicast_server_reconfig
methods.description: Reconfigures a unicast stream with a new codec configuration.

methods.name: bt_bap_unicast_server_start
methods.description: Starts streaming on a unicast stream if conditions are met.

methods.name: bt_bap_unicast_server_metadata
methods.description: Sets metadata for a unicast stream.

methods.name: bt_bap_unicast_server_config_ase
methods.description: Configures an Audio Stream Endpoint (ASE) for a unicast stream.

methods.name: bt_bap_unicast_server_foreach_ep
methods.description: Iterates over all endpoints for a given connection, applying a callback function.
